description: This file provides user data services for a weather dashboard frontend, including functions to add, remove, and list favorite locations and recent searches, utilizing a Supabase client for database interactions.

methods.name: sanitizeText
methods.description: Sanitizes input text by trimming, removing control characters and certain symbols, and limiting length.

methods.name: addFavoriteLocation
methods.description: Adds a favorite location for a user in the database.

methods.name: removeFavoriteLocation
methods.description: Removes a favorite location for a user from the database.

methods.name: listFavoriteLocations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of favorite locations for a user.

methods.name: addRecentSearch
methods.description: Adds a recent search query for a user and prunes older entries beyond the limit.

methods.name: listRecentSearches
methods.description: Lists recent search queries for a user.
